title: feat: rename Connected Apps MCP to Connectors
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Renames the hosted Connected Apps MCP to Connectors across the registry, dashboard, and docs.
- Keeps the account-management section named Connected apps.
- Preserves the composio server ID and endpoint so existing agents continue working.
- Updates catalog and docs tests.

gist.headline: Same plugs, clearer label
gist.blurb: The hosted MCP gets a shorter name: Connectors. The wires stay put, so existing agents can carry on without learning a new trick.
gist.summary: The hosted Connected Apps MCP is renamed Connectors in the registry, dashboard, and docs, while the account section remains Connected apps and the composio server ID and endpoint stay unchanged.
gist.impact: People get a clearer name for the hosted MCP; existing agents keep working with the same composio server ID and endpoint.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy garden workbench where Polli relabels a small MCP connector box from Connected Apps to Connectors without unplugging its cable. A separate account notebook still reads Connected apps; code-plants and flowers make the unchanged connection feel tangible.
gist.image_prompt: At a cozy pixel-art garden workbench, Polli gently places a 'Connectors' label on a small MCP box while its cable stays plugged into a glowing code-plant; a nearby notebook reads 'Connected apps'. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny tool belt, stays small-to-medium in the scene, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, mint, and dark purple (#110518) details.
